-- Epidemiolog -> REPORTS: + CREATE, UPDATE (READ/EXPORT allaqachon bor) INSERT INTO role_permission_actions (role_permission_id, action_id) SELECT rp.id, a.id FROM role_permissions rp JOIN role r ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN action a ON a.code IN ('CREATE', 'UPDATE') WHERE r.name = 'isemid_epidemiologist' AND p.subject = 'REPORTS' ON CONFLICT (role_permission_id, action_id) DO NOTHING;
-- Bo'lim mudiri (epidim_head) -> REPORTS: + UPDATE (READ/EXPORT allaqachon bor) INSERT INTO role_permission_actions (role_permission_id, action_id) SELECT rp.id, a.id FROM role_permissions rp JOIN role r ON r.id = rp.role_id JOIN permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id JOIN action a ON a.code = 'UPDATE' WHERE r.name = 'isemid_epidim_head' AND p.subject = 'REPORTS' ON CONFLICT (role_permission_id, action_id) DO NOTHING;
